definitions.explanation: A school system where students attend classes during regular daytime hours on a full-time basis, as opposed to evening or correspondence programs.

examples.japanese: {全日制|ぜんにちせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I attend a full-time high school.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全日制|ぜんにちせい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{定時制|ていじせい}→定時制：19786_teijisei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This school has both full-time and part-time programs.

examples.japanese: {全日制|ぜんにちせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{課程|かてい}→課程：02653_katei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月曜|げつよう}→月曜：30298_getsuyou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{金曜|きんよう}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In the full-time program, there are classes every day from Monday to Friday.

notes:
A compound of {全日|ぜんにち} (all day/full day) and ⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧ (system). Most commonly used in the context of Japanese high schools, which are categorized into three types: {全日制|ぜんにちせい} (full-time), ⟦{定時制|ていじせい}→定時制：19786_teijisei⟧ (part-time/evening), and ⟦{通信制|つうしんせい}→通信制：17890_tsuushinsei⟧ (correspondence). The vast majority of Japanese high school students attend {全日制|ぜんにちせい} programs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全日制|ぜんにちせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧ — full-time high school
- {全日制|ぜんにちせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{課程|かてい}→課程：02653_katei⟧ — full-time program/course
- {全日制|ぜんにちせい}{普通科|ふつうか} — full-time general course

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{定時制|ていじせい}→定時制：19786_teijisei⟧ — part-time school system (evening school; classes typically held from late afternoon)
- ⟦{通信制|つうしんせい}→通信制：17890_tsuushinsei⟧ — correspondence school system (distance learning)
- ⟦{夜間|やかん}→夜間：04133_yakan⟧ — nighttime/evening (used attributively: ⟦{夜間|やかん}{学校|がっこう}→夜間学校：27061_yakangakkou⟧, night school)
